name: .38 Revolver
text: +2 Brawn in combat.
flavor: Six shots. Count them.

name: Baling Hook
text: +1 Brawn in combat.
flavor: Made for cotton bales. Works on worse.

name: Pump Shotgun
text: +3 Brawn in combat.
flavor: Loud enough to wake the dead. That is sometimes a problem.

name: Thompson Gun
text: +4 Brawn in combat. -1 Wits when you evade. It is heavy.
flavor: Borrowed from a Chicago gentleman who will want it back.

name: Trench Knife
text: +1 Brawn in combat. You may discard it to add 2 dice to a fight.
flavor: A brass-knuckle grip and a bad reputation.

boosts.text: Discard it for +2 dice in this fight.

name: Bundle of Dynamite
text: Discard to add 4 dice to a fight.
flavor: Stolen from a mining camp. The fuses are short.

boosts.text: Light the fuse: +4 dice in this fight, then discard it.

name: Field Journal
text: +1 Lore. Action: test Lore (-1). If you pass, gain 1 Clue.
flavor: Twenty years of notes, and the last pages are in someone else's hand.

action.text: Study your notes: test Lore (-1). If you pass, gain 1 Clue.

name: Crumbling Grimoire
text: Action: test Lore (-1). If you pass, gain 1 Spell. If you fail, lose 1 Sanity.
flavor: The binding is human skin. The ink is not ink.

action.text: Read the grimoire: test Lore (-1). Pass: gain 1 Spell. Fail: lose 1 Sanity.

name: Storm Lantern
text: +1 Wits when you investigate.
flavor: Light pushes the dark back. Only a little.

name: Field Glasses
text: +1 Wits when you investigate or evade.
flavor: See it before it sees you.

name: Doctor's Bag
text: Action: an investigator here recovers 2 Health.
flavor: Catgut, carbolic, and a bottle of laudanum.

action.text: Treat wounds: an investigator here recovers 2 Health.

name: Flask of Whiskey
text: Action: discard it to recover 2 Sanity.
flavor: Prohibition is for people who have not seen what you have seen.

action.text: Take a long drink: recover 2 Sanity, then discard it.

name: Rabbit's Foot
text: Once per round, add 1 die to any test.
flavor: It was not lucky for the rabbit.

name: Blessed Rosary
text: +1 Nerve against horror.
flavor: Worn smooth by a hundred years of prayer.

name: Folding Camera
text: +1 Wits when you investigate. +1 Charm when you raise funds. Newspapers pay for pictures.
flavor: Some of the photographs show things that were not there when you took them.

name: Diving Rig
text: +1 to every test while you are at sea.
flavor: A brass helmet, a canvas suit, and forty feet of hose.

name: Mountaineering Kit
text: +1 to every test while you are in the wilderness.
flavor: Ropes, pitons, and a tin of pemmican.

name: First-Class Rail Pass
text: Your first rail or sea step each Travel is free.
flavor: Valid on every line from Calais to Constantinople, and some that are not on the map.

name: Forged Papers
text: Action: discard them to discard every Legal condition.
flavor: Your name is now Mr. or Mrs. Smith.

action.text: Show the papers: discard every Legal condition, then discard them.

name: Professor Edmund Hale
text: +1 Lore. Action: test Lore. If you pass, gain 1 Clue.
flavor: Retired from the chair of comparative mythology. He did not retire from the subject.

action.text: Ask the professor: test Lore. If you pass, gain 1 Clue.

name: Mickey Sullivan, Bodyguard
text: +2 Brawn in combat.
flavor: Ex-Navy, ex-boxer, ex-convict. Loyal to whoever paid him last.

name: Nurse Ruth Okafor
text: Action: an investigator here recovers 1 Health and 1 Sanity.
flavor: She has seen field hospitals in three wars. Nothing surprises her now.

action.text: Ruth's care: an investigator here recovers 1 Health and 1 Sanity.

name: Jack "Ace" Morrow, Pilot
text: Your first rail or sea step each Travel is free. +1 Nerve against horror.
flavor: He flew in France. He does not talk about what he saw above the clouds.

name: Madame Zora, Medium
text: +1 Lore when you cast. Once per round, add 2 dice to a horror check.
flavor: Half of her act is fake. She will not say which half.

boosts.text: Zora steadies you: +2 dice against horror.

name: A Night at the Grand Hotel
text: Recover 2 Health and 2 Sanity.
flavor: Clean sheets, hot water, and a door that locks.

name: Paid Informant
text: Gain 1 Clue.
flavor: He knows a man who knows a man.

name: Retain a Lawyer
text: Discard every Legal condition.
flavor: Expensive, discreet, and very good at paperwork.

name: Private Sanitarium
text: Discard every Madness condition and recover 1 Sanity.
flavor: Quiet gardens, high walls, and doctors who do not ask questions.
